requirement_results.explanation: The pytest run shows exit_code=1 with 2 failures: test_summary_has_a_visible_widget and test_empty_trace_clears_old_details. The test_summary_has_a_visible_widget fails because there is no Label widget bound to summary_var in the UI. The test_empty_trace_clears_old_details fails because load_file does not clear the detail text before processing new events. Both issues are in observatory.py and need to be fixed.

findings: Add a Label widget bound to summary_var in _build_ui, placing it below the subtitle and above the button frame
In load_file, call self.detail.delete('1.0', tk.END) at the start of the function to clear old detail text before processing new events
Ensure canvas scrollregion is configured after canvas is packed in _build_ui using canvas.pack_propagate(False) and canvas.create_window(0, 0, width=1000, height=680) to set scrollregion
Ensure horizontal scrollbar command is wired to canvas.xview in _build_ui using scrollbar.configure(command=self.canvas.xview)
